name: BottomSheet
description: Presentational bottom-sheet container for the React Native mobile app — white panel with rounded top corners, sticky-style header (grabber + title + optional action button), content, and footer/bottom-pad. Modal behavior (scrim, motion, positioning) stays with the caller.
notes: Header fade and action button's backdrop blur are approximated with a flat AlphaWhite40 tint (no expo-linear-gradient/expo-blur dependency yet).
